latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Image to PDF Merger skill.
- Merge multiple images into a single PDF with auto-rotation for proper orientation.
- Supports file renaming using a structured Excel index for generating filenames with voucher number, ship name, and description.
- Scan PDF OCR function included for extracting text from scanned PDFs using Tesseract.
- Added guidance for batch file collection, correct Excel column access, robust error handling, and automated Telegram sending.
- Introduced wait/delay mechanism to ensure all images are fully received before starting processing.
